currentWork.title: AN15 real evidence accumulation gate — normal-field evidence path audit
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.32 remains complete and production-verified. AN15 numeric promotion remains disabled. Repository audit on 2026-10-07 found that after FINAL.21 withdrew the user-facing Analysis/OCR surfaces, the current normal UI no longer reaches the AN15 forecast-ledger snapshot trigger or a supported confirmed-sales outcome path.
rootCause: an15-lifecycle-integration.js snapshots forecasts by wrapping the public VENDRIVE2Analytics.analysis.sales.listForecasts() API.
The current index.html has no analysisPage DOM and no 帳票撮影 entry point after FINAL.21; its retained Analysis JavaScript is unreachable from the shipped UI.
Normal internal recommendation/planning code calls the analytics.js closure-level listSalesForecasts() directly, so it bypasses the AN15 public-API wrapper.

AN15 scoring requires a newly confirmed sales report whose exact previousClearAt -> observedAt interval matches the stored forecast asOf -> targetAt interval. The user-facing report-confirmation path is withdrawn.
The legacy JSON backup exports core state plus vendrive2_last_day only; AN15 forecast/context localStorage ledgers are not included.
scope: No FINAL.32 gate was rerun because no FINAL.32 precondition changed.
No production code was changed in this audit.
No learned numeric correction was promoted.
Do not silently restore OCR/Analysis or weaken exact interval matching merely to increase sample count.
The next engineering action depends on a product decision about how real sales outcomes should be captured with acceptable field-work friction.
